items.desc: Open source personal agent with its own computer. It chases invoices, preps your calls and cancels trials on real websites, and asks before it acts. Runs on your machine with the model you choose. By n8n.
Claude Code and Codex working as one team: one shared memory (voice included), each sees the other's latest messages. Plus searchable notes, self health checks, and phone access with the laptop shut.
